meanings.explanation: An [auditorium] is a big room or hall where many people sit together to watch a show, listen to a concert, or join a school meeting.

examples.english: Our school [auditorium] has a big red curtain on the stage.
examples.chinese: 我们学校的[礼堂]的舞台上有一面大大的红幕布。

examples.english: We sat in the [auditorium] and watched a funny play.
examples.chinese: 我们坐在[礼堂]里看了一场有趣的表演。

examples.english: The whole class went to the [auditorium] for the morning assembly.
examples.chinese: 全班同学都去[礼堂]参加晨会了。

meanings.explanation: [Cooperation] is when people work together to do something or help each other.

examples.english: With good [cooperation], our group finished the project quickly.
examples.chinese: 有了良好的[合作]，我们小组很快就完成了任务。

examples.english: The teacher asked for everyone's [cooperation] to keep the classroom clean.
examples.chinese: 老师请大家[配合]保持教室干净。

examples.english: My brother and I cleaned our room through [cooperation].
examples.chinese: 我和哥哥通过[合作]把房间打扫干净了。

meanings.explanation: [Bacteria] are very tiny living things that can only be seen through a microscope. Some can make you sick, while others are helpful.

examples.english: Washing your hands with soap can kill most [bacteria].
examples.chinese: 用肥皂洗手可以杀死大部分[细菌]。

examples.english: Yogurt contains good [bacteria] that are healthy for your stomach.
examples.chinese: 酸奶含有对肠胃有益的[益生菌]。

examples.english: A single [bacterium] can multiply into millions in just a few hours.
examples.chinese: 一个[细菌]只需几小时就能繁殖出数百万个。

meanings.explanation: A [characteristic] is a special quality or feature that someone or something has.

examples.english: One [characteristic] of a good friend is that they always listen to you.
examples.chinese: 好朋友的一个[特点]是他们会一直听你说话。

examples.english: Polar bears have a thick white coat, which is a [characteristic] of animals living in cold places.
examples.chinese: 北极熊有厚厚的白色皮毛，这是生活在寒冷地区动物的一个[特征]。

examples.english: Being very curious is a [characteristic] of many young children.
examples.chinese: 非常好奇是许多小孩子的一个[特点]。

meanings.explanation: A [budget] is a plan that shows how much money you have available to spend and how you will spend it.

examples.english: My mom makes a [budget] for our family every month.
examples.chinese: 我妈妈每个月都会给我们家做一份[预算]。

examples.english: I have a small [budget] for buying new toys this month.
examples.chinese: 这个月我买新玩具的[预算]很少。

examples.english: Our class used our [budget] to buy new art supplies.
examples.chinese: 我们班用[预算]买了新的美术用品。

meanings.explanation: If someone is [accomplished], they are very skilled or very successful at something.

examples.english: My sister is an [accomplished] piano player.
examples.chinese: 我姐姐是一位[出色的]钢琴演奏者。

examples.english: He became an [accomplished] swimmer after years of practice.
examples.chinese: 经过多年练习，他成了一位[厉害的]游泳健将。

examples.english: Our teacher is an [accomplished] storyteller.
examples.chinese: 我们的老师是一位[出色的]故事大王。

derived_forms: Federal Bureau of Investigation (full official name)

meanings.explanation: The [FBI] is the main federal law enforcement agency in the United States that investigates serious crimes.

examples.english: My dad saw an [FBI] agent on TV yesterday.
examples.chinese: 我爸爸昨天在电视上看到了一名[联邦调查局]特工。

examples.english: The [FBI] works to solve big crimes in America.
examples.chinese: [联邦调查局]在美国负责侦破重大犯罪案件。

examples.english: My favorite TV show follows a team of [FBI] agents solving cases.
examples.chinese: 我最喜欢的电视剧讲的是一队[联邦调查局]特工破案的故事。

meanings.explanation: To [cause] something means to make it happen or be the reason for it.

examples.english: Rain [causes] the ground to get wet.
examples.chinese: 下雨[导致]地面变湿。

examples.english: Eating too much candy can [cause] a stomachache.
examples.chinese: 吃太多糖会[导致]肚子疼。

examples.english: What [caused] the cup to fall?
examples.chinese: 是什么[导致]杯子掉了？

meanings.explanation: A [catalog] is a book or a list that shows pictures and information about things you can buy or find, like toys, books, or clothes.

examples.english: I looked at the toy [catalog] and found a robot I really like.
examples.chinese: 我翻了翻玩具[目录]，找到了一个我很喜欢的机器人。

examples.english: Our school library has a big [catalog] of books.
examples.chinese: 我们学校图书馆有一本很厚的图书[目录]。

examples.english: Mom ordered a dress from the clothing [catalog].
examples.chinese: 妈妈从服装[目录]里订购了一条连衣裙。

meanings.explanation: If something or someone is [demanding], it needs a lot of time, effort, or attention.

examples.english: My math teacher is very [demanding]. She always wants us to do our best.
examples.chinese: 我的数学老师非常[严格]，她总是要求我们做到最好。

examples.english: Playing the piano is a [demanding] hobby. You need to practice every day.
examples.chinese: 弹钢琴是一项很[费功夫]的爱好，你每天都得练习。

examples.english: Soccer training is really [demanding]. I am always tired after practice.
examples.chinese: 足球训练真的很[辛苦]，练完之后我总是很累。

meanings.explanation: An [essay] is a short piece of writing about a certain topic, usually written for a class or a school assignment.

examples.english: I have to write an [essay] about my favorite animal for homework.
examples.chinese: 我回到家得写一篇关于我最喜欢的动物的[作文]。

examples.english: My teacher said my [essay] on spring was very nice.
examples.chinese: 老师说我写春天的[作文]写得很好。

examples.english: She wrote a short [essay] about why she loves reading books.
examples.chinese: 她写了一篇关于为什么喜欢读书的短[作文]。

meanings.explanation: An [expert] is a person who knows a lot about something or is very good at doing something.

examples.english: My dad is an [expert] at fixing bicycles.
examples.chinese: 我爸爸是修自行车的[能手]。

examples.english: We invited an [expert] to teach us how to draw animals.
examples.chinese: 我们请了一位[专家]来教我们画动物。

examples.english: Lily is an [expert] at playing chess and she never loses.
examples.chinese: 莉莉是下国际象棋的[高手]，她从来不会输。

meanings.explanation: A [disease] is an illness that makes your body feel bad and needs a doctor to help you get better.

examples.english: Washing your hands can help stop the [disease] from spreading.
examples.chinese: 洗手可以帮助阻止[疾病]传播。

examples.english: The doctor gave her medicine to fight the [disease].
examples.chinese: 医生给她开了药来对抗[疾病]。

examples.english: Many children get a [disease] called chickenpox.
examples.chinese: 很多孩子会得一种叫水痘的[疾病]。

meanings.explanation: If you [exhibit] something, you show it to the public so that people can look at it.

examples.english: The children will [exhibit] their science projects at the school fair.
examples.chinese: 孩子们将在学校展会上[展示]他们的科学项目。

examples.english: Tom [exhibited] his toy car collection at the class party.
examples.chinese: 汤姆在班级聚会上[展示]了他的玩具车收藏。

examples.english: Our class [exhibited] good teamwork during the game.
examples.chinese: 我们班在比赛中[表现出]了良好的团队合作。

meanings.explanation: A [cue] is a signal that tells you it is the right time to do something.

examples.english: In our school play, the dark lighting was my [cue] to open the big curtain.
examples.chinese: 在我们的校园剧里，灯光变暗就是我拉开大幕的[提示]。

examples.english: When we play hide-and-seek, the countdown is your [cue] to go find a hiding place.
examples.chinese: 我们玩捉迷藏时，倒计时就是你去找藏身之处的[信号]。

examples.english: My mom gave me a [cue] to say goodbye to our guests when it got late.
examples.chinese: 天晚了，妈妈给我[提示]让我跟客人说再见。

meanings.explanation: If you [analyze] something, you examine it carefully in order to understand it or find out more about it.

examples.english: My dad helps me [analyze] my math mistakes every night.
examples.chinese: 爸爸每天晚上帮我[分析]我的数学错题。

examples.english: The science teacher asked us to [analyze] leaves under the microscope.
examples.chinese: 科学老师让我们在显微镜下[分析]树叶。

examples.english: I need to [analyze] why my soccer team lost the game.
examples.chinese: 我需要[分析]我的足球队为什么输了比赛。

meanings.explanation: A [factory] is a large building where people use machines to make things like toys, cars, or clothes.

examples.english: My dad works in a [factory] that makes bicycles.
examples.chinese: 我爸爸在一家生产自行车的[工厂]上班。

examples.english: This toy [factory] makes thousands of teddy bears every day.
examples.chinese: 这家玩具[工厂]每天生产成千上万只泰迪熊。

examples.english: The workers at the shoe [factory] make beautiful shoes for children.
examples.chinese: 那家鞋[厂]的工人为孩子们制作漂亮的鞋子。

meanings.explanation: A [footprint] is the mark that your foot or shoe leaves on a surface like sand, mud, or snow when you step on it.

examples.english: I saw a big dog [footprint] in the mud outside my house.
examples.chinese: 我在屋外的泥地里看到了一个大大的狗[脚印]。

examples.english: The children made [footprints] in the fresh snow on their way to school.
examples.chinese: 孩子们在上学路上的新雪里踩出了一串[脚印]。

examples.english: We followed the rabbit's [footprints] through the garden to find where it went.
examples.chinese: 我们跟着兔子的[脚印]穿过花园，看它跑去了哪里。

meanings.explanation: A [fingerprint] is the special pattern of lines on the tip of your finger, and no two people have the same one.

examples.english: Everyone's [fingerprint] is different, just like a snowflake.
examples.chinese: 每个人的[指纹]都是不一样的，就像雪花一样。

examples.english: Mom uses her [fingerprint] to unlock her phone.
examples.chinese: 妈妈用她的[指纹]来解锁手机。

examples.english: The police can find a [fingerprint] on a door handle.
examples.chinese: 警察可以在门把手上发现一个[指纹]。

meanings.explanation: [Expertise] is special knowledge or skill in a particular subject or activity.

examples.english: My aunt has a lot of [expertise] in cooking delicious meals.
examples.chinese: 我姑姑在烹饪美食方面很有[专长]。

examples.english: The teacher's [expertise] in math helped us understand hard problems.
examples.chinese: 老师在数学方面的[专业知识]帮助我们理解了难题。

examples.english: He showed his [expertise] by fixing the broken bike in minutes.
examples.chinese: 他几分钟就修好了坏掉的自行车，展现了[高超技能]。

meanings.explanation: A [germ] is a very tiny living thing that can make you sick. You cannot see it with your eyes, but it is everywhere.

examples.english: Wash your hands with soap to get rid of [germs].
examples.chinese: 用肥皂洗手可以洗掉[细菌]。

examples.english: Cover your mouth when you cough so [germs] don't spread.
examples.chinese: 咳嗽时捂住嘴，这样[细菌]就不会传播了。

examples.english: Fruits and vegetables have [germs] on them, so we need to wash them before eating.
examples.chinese: 水果和蔬菜上面有[细菌]，所以吃之前要洗干净。

common_collocations: give a conclusion at the end
give a conclusion after a discussion

meanings.explanation: If you [give a conclusion], you tell people the final answer or the most important result after you have thought about or discussed something.

examples.english: After the group discussion, our teacher [gave a conclusion].
examples.chinese: 小组讨论结束后，老师做了[总结]。

examples.english: At the end of her talk, Lily [gave a conclusion] about why we should protect animals.
examples.chinese: 在演讲的最后，莉莉就为什么应该保护动物做了[总结]。

examples.english: Can you [give a conclusion] about what we learned today?
examples.chinese: 你能对今天学到的东西[做个总结]吗？

meanings.explanation: A [facility] is a special place or building that is designed for a particular purpose, such as playing sports, learning, or keeping people healthy.

examples.english: Our school has a new sports [facility] with a big swimming pool and a basketball court.
examples.chinese: 我们学校有一个新的体育[设施]，里面有个大游泳池和篮球场。

examples.english: The library [facility] has many storybooks and a quiet room for reading.
examples.chinese: 这家图书馆[设施]有很多故事书，还有一个安静的阅读室。

examples.english: Our city built more play [facilities] in the park so children can have fun.
examples.chinese: 我们城市在公园里建了更多游乐[设施]，让孩子们可以开心玩耍。

common_collocations: find the cause of a problem
find the cause of an illness
find the cause of a mistake

meanings.explanation: When you [find the cause] of something that has happened, you discover why it happened.

examples.english: The doctor needs to [find the cause] of my sister's cough.
examples.chinese: 医生需要[找到原因]才能治好姐姐的咳嗽。

examples.english: My teacher helped us [find the cause] of our experiment's mistake.
examples.chinese: 老师帮我们[找出原因]，改正了实验的错误。

examples.english: I can't [find the cause] of why my phone won't turn on.
examples.chinese: 我没法[找到原因]，不知道我的手机为什么开不了机。

meanings.explanation: A [heated] conversation or argument is one in which people feel very strongly, get angry, or talk in an excited and intense way.

examples.english: My parents had a [heated] argument about where to go on vacation.
examples.chinese: 我爸妈为了去哪儿度假吵得[很激烈]。

examples.english: The students had a [heated] discussion about which game is the best.
examples.chinese: 同学们为了哪个游戏最好玩争得[面红耳赤]。

examples.english: Our class had a [heated] debate about whether homework should be given on weekends.
examples.chinese: 我们班就周末该不该留作业展开了一场[激烈的]辩论。

meanings.explanation: Something that is [germy] is covered with tiny harmful germs that can make you sick.

examples.english: This dirty kitchen sponge is [germy].
examples.chinese: 这块脏厨房海绵[满是细菌]。

examples.english: Don't let your [germy] hands touch my cookie.
examples.chinese: 别让你[带细菌的]手碰我的饼干。

examples.english: After playing in the dirt, your shoes can get pretty [germy].
examples.chinese: 在泥土里玩完后，你的鞋子会变得[满是细菌]。

common_collocations: buzz someone in on the intercom

meanings.explanation: An [intercom] is an electronic device that lets people talk to each other from different rooms or parts of a building.

examples.english: Mom used the [intercom] to call me downstairs for dinner.
examples.chinese: 妈妈用[对讲机]喊我下楼吃饭。

examples.english: The teacher spoke through the [intercom] to tell everyone it was time for recess.
examples.chinese: 老师通过[广播]告诉大家该休息了。

examples.english: Our apartment has an [intercom] so we can talk to visitors at the front door.
examples.chinese: 我们公寓有个[门禁对讲机]，可以和前门的访客说话。

meanings.explanation: A [handicap] is something that makes it harder for you to do something or to succeed.

examples.english: Wearing big boots was a [handicap] when I tried to run fast.
examples.chinese: 穿着大靴子跑步对我来说是个[障碍]。

examples.english: Not having a ruler was a [handicap] in our math test.
examples.chinese: 数学考试没有尺子真是个[麻烦]。

examples.english: The rain was a [handicap] for our picnic in the park.
examples.chinese: 下雨对我们去公园野餐是个[不利条件]。

meanings.explanation: If someone is [handicapped] by something, they are put at a disadvantage or have difficulty doing things because of that thing.

examples.english: Our team was [handicapped] by the heavy rain and lost the game.
examples.chinese: 我们队因为大雨而[处于劣势]，输掉了比赛。

examples.english: She was [handicapped] by her broken arm and could not write her homework.
examples.chinese: 她因为手臂骨折而[不方便]，没法写作业。

examples.english: The runner was [handicapped] by a sore leg, but he still finished the race.
examples.chinese: 那名选手因为腿疼而[受影响]，但他还是跑完了全程。

meanings.explanation: Something that is [intricate] has many small parts or details arranged in a complicated way that is often hard to follow or understand.

examples.english: The small watch has [intricate] gears inside its case.
examples.chinese: 这块小小的手表表壳里有着[复杂精巧]的齿轮。

examples.english: My little sister enjoys coloring [intricate] mandala drawings.
examples.chinese: 我妹妹喜欢给[复杂精细]的曼陀罗画上色。

examples.english: The spider spun an [intricate] web between two tree branches.
examples.chinese: 蜘蛛在两根树枝间织了一张[错综复杂]的网。

meanings.explanation: If you [give an example], you mention a specific thing to help explain what you mean.

examples.english: Can you [give an example] of your favorite food?
examples.chinese: 你能[举一个]你最喜欢的食物的例子吗？

examples.english: The teacher [gave an example] to help us understand the math problem.
examples.chinese: 老师[举了一个例子]来帮我们理解这道数学题。

examples.english: Let me [give an example] so you know what I mean.
examples.chinese: 让我[举个例子]，你就明白我的意思了。

meanings.explanation: A [gene] is a tiny part of the cells in living things that passes physical characteristics from parents to their children.

examples.english: A [gene] from your parents determines what color your eyes will be.
examples.chinese: 来自父母的一个[基因]决定了你眼睛的颜色。

examples.english: Scientists have found a [gene] that affects how tall plants grow.
examples.chinese: 科学家发现了一个影响植物生长高度的[基因]。

examples.english: Every [gene] in your body carries information that makes you unique.
examples.chinese: 你体内的每个[基因]都携带着让你独一无二的信息。

meanings.explanation: [Information about] something is facts or details that tell you more about that thing.

examples.english: I want to find [information about] dinosaurs for my school project.
examples.chinese: 我想为学校项目找到关于恐龙的[信息]。

examples.english: Mom got some [information about] the summer camp from the website.
examples.chinese: 妈妈从网站上了解到了一些关于夏令营的[信息]。

examples.english: The teacher gave us [information about] the class trip next week.
examples.chinese: 老师给了我们关于下周班级旅行的[信息]。

meanings.explanation: An [investigation] is the careful process of trying to find out the truth or the answer to a question about something that happened.

examples.english: The teacher started an [investigation] to find out who broke the classroom window.
examples.chinese: 老师开始[调查]，想找出是谁打破了教室的窗户。

examples.english: After a week of [investigation], the police found the lost dog.
examples.chinese: 经过一周的[调查]，警察找到了那只走失的狗。

examples.english: Mom did an [investigation] in the kitchen to see who ate all the cookies.
examples.chinese: 妈妈在厨房里[调查]了一番，想看看是谁吃光了所有饼干。

meanings.explanation: A [laser] is a special device that makes a very thin, strong, and bright beam of light.

examples.english: The doctor used a [laser] to fix my dad's eyes.
examples.chinese: 医生用[激光]治好了我爸爸的眼睛。

examples.english: My cat loves to chase the red dot from a [laser] on the floor.
examples.chinese: 我家猫咪特别喜欢追地上[激光笔]照出来的红点。

examples.english: A [laser] can cut through metal very quickly.
examples.chinese: [激光]能很快地切开金属。

meanings.explanation: An [investigator] is a person whose job is to find out the truth about something, such as a crime, an accident, or a mystery.

examples.english: The police [investigator] asked everyone questions about the missing bike.
examples.chinese: 警察[调查员]向每个人询问了自行车丢失的情况。

examples.english: A clever [investigator] found the lost cat by looking for clues.
examples.chinese: 一名聪明的[调查员]通过寻找线索找到了走失的猫。

examples.english: My uncle works as a private [investigator] and helps people solve problems.
examples.chinese: 我叔叔是一名私家[侦探]，帮人们解决难题。

meanings.explanation: [Homesickness] is the sad feeling you get when you are away from your home and family and you miss them very much.

examples.english: Tom felt a bad case of [homesickness] on the first night of summer camp.
examples.chinese: 夏令营第一晚，汤姆[想家]想得厉害。

examples.english: Writing letters to her parents helped Lily overcome her [homesickness].
examples.chinese: 给父母写信帮助莉莉克服了[想家]的感觉。

examples.english: Many children suffer from [homesickness] when they study abroad for the first time.
examples.chinese: 很多孩子第一次出国留学时都会[想家]。

meanings.explanation: A [lecture] is a long talk given to a group of people to teach them about something.

examples.english: Our teacher gave us a [lecture] about rainforests today.
examples.chinese: 今天老师给我们做了一场关于热带雨林的[讲座]。

examples.english: I learned many new facts in the science [lecture].
examples.chinese: 我在这场科学[讲座]上学到了很多新知识。

examples.english: My dad went to a [lecture] about gardening last weekend.
examples.chinese: 我爸爸上周末去听了一场关于园艺的[讲座]。

meanings.explanation: If something happens [on account of] something else, it happens because of that thing.

examples.english: We stayed home [on account of] the heavy rain.
examples.chinese: 我们[因为]下大雨就待在家里了。

examples.english: The picnic was canceled [on account of] the bad weather.
examples.chinese: 野餐[因为]天气不好取消了。

examples.english: She was late for school [on account of] the bus breaking down.
examples.chinese: 她[因为]公交车坏了所以上学迟到了。

meanings.explanation: An [orchestra] is a large group of musicians who play different musical instruments together.

examples.english: My cousin plays the violin in the school [orchestra].
examples.chinese: 我表哥在学校[管弦乐团]拉小提琴。

examples.english: The [orchestra] played beautiful music at the concert yesterday.
examples.chinese: 昨天[管弦乐团]在音乐会上演奏了动听的乐曲。

examples.english: I want to join the [orchestra] when I learn to play the cello.
examples.chinese: 等我学会拉大提琴，我也想加入[管弦乐团]。

meanings.explanation: A [poem] is a piece of writing that uses beautiful words, rhythm, and sometimes rhyme to express feelings or tell a story.

examples.english: I wrote a [poem] about my cat for homework.
examples.chinese: 我写了一首关于我家小猫的[诗]当作业。

examples.english: My mom likes to read [poems] to me before bed.
examples.chinese: 妈妈喜欢睡觉前给我读[诗]。

examples.english: Our teacher showed us a short [poem] about spring.
examples.chinese: 老师给我们念了一首描写春天的短[诗]。

meanings.explanation: If something is [mandatory], you must do it because of a rule or law.

examples.english: Wearing a seatbelt is [mandatory] in the car.
examples.chinese: 在车里系安全带是[必须的]。

examples.english: The school uniform is [mandatory] for all students.
examples.chinese: 校服对所有学生来说是[强制性的]。

examples.english: It is [mandatory] to raise your hand before speaking in class.
examples.chinese: 上课发言前举手是[必须的]。

meanings.explanation: A [link] is a connection between two things or people.

examples.english: I clicked the [link] and it opened a fun game.
examples.chinese: 我点了那个[链接]，然后打开了一个好玩的游戏。

examples.english: The new road is a [link] between the two villages.
examples.chinese: 这条新路是两个村子之间的[连接]。

examples.english: There is a close [link] between eating fruit and staying healthy.
examples.chinese: 吃水果和保持健康之间有很紧密的[联系]。

meanings.explanation: A [portrayal] is the way someone or something is shown or described in a book, movie, play, or painting.

examples.english: This book gives a warm [portrayal] of a happy family.
examples.chinese: 这本书对幸福家庭做了温暖的[描绘]。

examples.english: Her [portrayal] of a brave princess in the school play was wonderful.
examples.chinese: 她在校园剧中扮演勇敢公主的[表演]非常精彩。

examples.english: The movie's [portrayal] of true friendship made everyone smile.
examples.chinese: 电影对真挚友谊的[刻画]让每个人都露出了笑容。

meanings.explanation: [Poetry] is writing that expresses feelings or ideas in a beautiful and imaginative way, often with a regular rhythm or rhyme.

examples.english: My mom reads [poetry] to me every night before bed.
examples.chinese: 妈妈每晚睡前都会给我读[诗]。

examples.english: We wrote our own [poetry] in class today.
examples.chinese: 今天我们在课堂上创作了自己的[诗歌]。

examples.english: I love the beautiful sound of this [poetry].
examples.chinese: 我喜欢这首[诗歌]的美妙声音。

meanings.explanation: You use [rather than] to say that you prefer one thing and do not want the other thing.

examples.english: I like to walk to school [rather than] take the bus.
examples.chinese: 我喜欢走路去学校，[而不是]坐公交车。

examples.english: She chose to draw a cat [rather than] a dog.
examples.chinese: 她选择画一只猫，[而不是]画狗。

examples.english: Let's play outside [rather than] watch TV all afternoon.
examples.chinese: 我们出去玩吧，[而不是]整个下午看电视。

meanings.explanation: A [prediction] is a statement that you make about what you think will happen in the future.

examples.english: The weatherman’s [prediction] says it will snow this weekend.
examples.chinese: 气象员的[预测]说这周末会下雪。

examples.english: My [prediction] is that my mom will bring cake for dinner.
examples.chinese: 我的[预测]是妈妈晚餐会带蛋糕回来。

examples.english: His [prediction] about the cartoon ending turned out to be right.
examples.chinese: 他对动画结局的[预测]结果是对的。

meanings.explanation: A [senator] is a person who is elected to help make laws for a country or state.

examples.english: The [senator] gave a speech at our school today.
examples.chinese: 那位[参议员]今天在我们学校发表了演讲。

examples.english: People in our state will vote for a new [senator] next month.
examples.chinese: 我们州的人下个月将投票选举一位新的[参议员]。

examples.english: My dad met a [senator] at the city hall yesterday.
examples.chinese: 我爸爸昨天在市政厅见到了一位[参议员]。

meanings.explanation: A [loan] is an amount of money that someone borrows from a bank or another person and agrees to pay back, usually over time.

examples.english: My parents took out a [loan] to buy our new car.
examples.chinese: 我爸妈[贷款]买了新车。

examples.english: The bank gave my aunt a [loan] to open her bakery.
examples.chinese: 银行给我阿姨[贷款]开了面包店。

examples.english: Tom's father pays back the [loan] for their house every month.
examples.chinese: 汤姆的爸爸每个月还房子的[贷款]。

meanings.explanation: A [ramp] is a flat surface that slopes up or down, so you can walk, ride, or roll something between two different levels.

examples.english: I rode my bike up the [ramp] and stopped at the top.
examples.chinese: 我骑着自行车上了[斜坡]，在坡顶停了下来。

examples.english: There is a wheelchair [ramp] at the school gate.
examples.chinese: 学校门口有一个轮椅[坡道]。

examples.english: We made a toy car [ramp] out of a big box.
examples.chinese: 我们用一个大纸箱做了一个玩具汽车[坡道]。

meanings.explanation: A [semester] is one of the two main periods into which a school or college year is divided.

examples.english: I will learn to play the guitar this [semester].
examples.chinese: 这[学期]我要学弹吉他。

examples.english: There are two exams each [semester].
examples.chinese: 每个[学期]有两次考试。

examples.english: Our school starts a new [semester] in September.
examples.chinese: 我们学校九月份开始新[学期]。

meanings.explanation: To [trim] something means to cut off a little bit to make it look neater.

examples.english: Mom helped me [trim] the paper so it fits nicely in the frame.
examples.chinese: 妈妈帮我[修剪]了一下纸张，让它正好放进相框里。

examples.english: Dad [trimmed] the hedges in the garden to make them look tidy.
examples.chinese: 爸爸[修剪]了花园里的灌木丛，让它们看起来整整齐齐的。

examples.english: I need to [trim] my hair because it's getting too long.
examples.chinese: 我需要[修剪]一下头发，因为太长了。

meanings.explanation: A [sequence] is a number of things that happen or are arranged one after another in a particular order.

examples.english: I can recite the [sequence] of letters in the alphabet.
examples.chinese: 我能背出字母表中字母的[顺序]。

examples.english: We follow the same [sequence] when we get ready for school every morning.
examples.chinese: 我们每天早上上学前都会按照同样的[顺序]做准备。

examples.english: I arranged the colored blocks in a [sequence] of red, blue, and green.
examples.chinese: 我把彩色积木按照红、蓝、绿的[顺序]排列好了。
